clips.title: The story
paras: The Color of Blood is a personal task given by Nikova Raskol, a grieving grandmother living in Stormwind City. Consumed by anger over the murder of her young grandson inside the city's prison, she hires adventurers to venture into The Stockade and claim the Defias gang's trademark red bandanas as retribution.

When Stormwind's regular military forces were deployed away to distant fronts, local defense fell upon volunteer recruits and the city's youth. Nikova Raskol's grandson, Mac, was only fourteen years old when he took up arms as a guard within The Stockade. Tasked with watching hardened criminals and mutinous members of the Defias Brotherhood, the young guard was thrust into an intensely dangerous environment far beyond his experience.

Behind bars, the captured Defias inmates began ripping apart their provided wool prison blankets, fashioning the shredded fabric into makeshift red bandanas. These crude garments served as identifying gang colors, signaling their continued loyalty to the Brotherhood even inside prison walls. When young Mac reprimanded the prisoners and tried to enforce discipline, the inmates stabbed the boy in the back, leaving him dead on the stone floor.

Devastated by Mac's pointless death, Nikova seeks cold revenge rather than official bureaucracy. She dispatches brave adventurers into the depths of The Stockade to cull the rioting prisoners and bring back ten of their cherished red bandanas—symbols dyed the color of her grandson's spilled blood. Presenting these blood-colored trophies offers a grim sense of closure to a broken family.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Bitterness flows through my veins like a cold river. My grandson, Mac, was such a good boy. A mere 14 years old. When the army was sent off to the front, Mac took up arms to defend the city. He was a guard in The Stockade, where the Defias gang is locked up. Mac reprimanded some of the prisoners for tearing their wool blankets to make scarves, a symbol of their gang. For that Mac was stabbed in the back.
I want revenge. Bring me 10 of their precious Wool Bandanas. They are the color of blood.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I see you are back, adventurer. Have you collected 10 Red Wool Bandanas from those Defias Scum in The Stockade yet?

clips.title: Completion
paras: So these bandanas -- filthy tokens of corruption -- are what my Mac had to die for? Such a waste. Such a tragic sacrifice.
But alas, I cannot return to the past. Just know, friend, that you have brought my family justice through your deeds.
